notes: The part between Luxmore Hut and Iris Burn Hut is on open ridge for about 5 hours. Strong wind, cold and snow are possible in any month.
You can end the walk at Rainbow Reach, about 1 hour 30 minutes after Moturau Hut, and take a shuttle to Te Anau.
Camping is permitted only at Brod Bay and Iris Burn.

moturau.name: Moturau Hut
moturau.note: DOC hut. You must book before you go. Facilities: cooking, heating, mattresses, lighting, flush toilets. Boil the water before you drink it.

start.name: Kepler Track car park
start.note: The car park at the lake control gates, 5 km from Te Anau. You can walk to it from the town along the lake in about 50 minutes.

pois.name: Iris Burn Falls
pois.text: Waterfall about 20 minutes from Iris Burn Hut.

pois.name: High point below Mount Luxmore
pois.text: The highest point of the track, about 1400 m. A side track of about 10 minutes climbs to the top of Mount Luxmore, 1472 m.

pois.name: Luxmore Cave
pois.text: Limestone cave on a side track, about 10 minutes from Luxmore Hut. Take a torch for each person.

pois.name: Rainbow Reach
pois.text: Car park and swing bridge over the Waiau River. The shuttle to Te Anau stops here.
